name_zh: 李舜臣：從文官到海軍將帥的『水陸轉換』體系與防禦反擊範式
name_en: Yi Sun-sin: From Civil Official to Naval Commander — the 'Land-to-Sea Transformation' System and Defensive Counterattack Paradigm
description_zh: 李舜臣（Yi Sun-sin，1545-1598）是朝鮮王朝最偉大的海軍將領，被韓國人尊為民族英雄和世界海戰史上的傳奇人物。他出身漢陽兩班（貴族）家庭，通過武科考試進入軍旅生涯。1583年以「別監」身份初次展現軍事才能，平定海盜。1587年被任命為全羅道左水使（該地區海軍司令），開始系統性地改革朝鮮海軍。日本文祿年間（1592年）豐臣秀吉發動侵朝戰爭（文祿・慶長之役），朝鮮水軍在戰爭初期幾乎被全滅。李舜臣臨危受命，僅率12艘戰船和5000名士兵應對日本300餘艘戰艦的優勢兵力。其核心思維貢獻在於將「水陸轉換」工程化為一套可操作的防禦反擊體系——通過設計龜船（Geobukseon，世界最早的裝甲艦之一）和鶴翼陣（Crane Wing Formation），將防禦型海軍轉化為進攻性戰略武器。李舜臣的獨特之處在於他既是文官（通過武科考試進入官僚體系）又是軍事家，深諳「以弱勝強」的非對稱戰爭理論，通過情報網絡（間諜系統）、地形利用（忠清南道黃海海域的狹窄水道）和創新戰術（「鷂子陣」、「月形陣」），在三次關鍵海戰中全殲日軍水師（閑居島之戰、泗川海戰、露梁海戰）。他是Protreptic中模式41（非對稱防禦作戰法）在東亞軍事傳統中的關鍵樣本，也是模式12（系統思維）在「海軍戰略工程化」場景的獨特代表。
description_en: Yi Sun-sin (1545-1598) was Korea's greatest naval commander during the Joseon Dynasty, revered by Koreans as national hero and legendary figure in world naval history. Born to Han-yang yangban (aristocrat) family, entered military career through Military Examination. In 1583 served as 'Byeolgam' (special inspector), first demonstrating military talent by suppressing pirates. Appointed Jeolla Province Left Naval Commander in 1587, systematically reformed Korean navy. During Bunroku Campaign (1592), Toyotomi Hideyoshi's invasion of Korea, Korean navy was nearly destroyed in early war. Yi Sun-sin took command in crisis with only 12 ships and 5000 soldiers facing over 300 Japanese vessels. His core thinking contribution lies in engineering a 'Land-to-Sea Transformation' into an operable defensive counterattack system — through designing Geobukseon (turtle ship, one of the world's earliest armored vessels) and Crane Wing Formation, transforming defensive navy into offensive strategic weapons. Yi's uniqueness lies in being both civil official (entering bureaucracy through Military Examination) and military strategist, deeply understanding asymmetric warfare theory of 'winning with weakness', utilizing intelligence networks (spy system), terrain exploitation (narrow waters of Chungcheong South Province Yellow Sea coast) and innovative tactics ('Falcon Array', 'Moon Formation'), completely annihilating Japanese navy in three crucial sea battles (Cherry Island, Sacheon, Noryang). He is a key sample of mode 41 (Asymmetric Defensive Combat) in East Asian military tradition and the unique representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'naval strategy engineering' scenarios.
reason_zh: 李舜臣填補了Protreptic在「非對稱防禦作戰法」領域的韓國空白。他是模式41（非對稱防禦作戰法）在「以弱勝強海戰」場景的唯一韓國完整樣本，展示了如何通過龜船設計、鶴翼陣和地形利用將防禦型海軍轉化為進攻性戰略武器；也是模式12（系統思維）在「文官將帥的軍事體系化」場景的唯一韓國代表。他的非對稱戰爭理論（情報+地形+創新戰術的三位一體）和「一寸也不能退」的忠誠精神，對現代防禦戰略和非對稱作戰具有深遠啟發價值。
reason_en: Yi Sun-sin fills Protreptic's Korean gap in 'Asymmetric Defensive Combat'. He is the only complete Korean sample of mode 41 (Asymmetric Defensive Combat) in 'winning with weakness at sea' scenarios, demonstrating how Geobukseon design, Crane Wing Formation and terrain exploitation transform defensive navy into offensive strategic weapons; also the sole Korean representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'civil official's military systematization' scenarios. His asymmetric warfare theory (intelligence + terrain + innovative tactics three-in-one) and 'not an inch to retreat' loyalty spirit have profound heuristic value for modern defense strategy and asymmetric combat.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式41非對稱防禦作戰法）：海軍改革的系統工程——在全羅道左水使任內，設計龜船（裝甲覆蓋、龍首砲口、可旋轉甲板）、改進箭筒和火槍配置，建立從1587年到1592年的系統性海軍改革規劃
第2步（模式12系統思維法）：情報網絡與地形利用——建立間諜系統獲取日軍動向，利用忠清南道黃海海域的狹窄水道和潮汐變化，在閑居島之戰（1592年7月）中僅用12艘戰船擊沉48艘日軍艦艇
第3步（模式7戰略預判法）：三次關鍵海戰的連續勝利——閑居島之戰（1592.7，擊沉48艘）、泗川海戰（1592.10，焚毀日軍戰艦300餘艘）、露梁海戰（1598.12，與明軍協同殲滅日軍主力），在幾乎沒有後勤支援的情況下連續取得戰略勝利
第4步（模式15框架效應法）：一寸也不能退的忠誠框架——通過「臣之死期至矣，然臣豈以死避敵」的誓言重新定義忠誠含義，將「不退」框架為國家存亡的文化符號（「一寸也不能退」成為韓國民族精神的象徵）
第5步（範式固化）：文官將帥的軍事體系——將「海軍改革→情報網絡→地形利用→忠誠框架」四環沉澱為可操作的非對稱防禦模板，證明了在絕對劣勢下通過系統思維和創新戰術可以取得戰略勝利
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 41 Asymmetric Defensive Combat): Systematic naval reform — as Jeolla Province Left Naval Commander, designed Geobukseon (armored coverage, dragon-head gunports, rotatable deck), improved arrow筒 and musket configurations, establishing systematic naval reform plan from 1587 to 1592

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Intelligence network and terrain exploitation — establishing spy system for Japanese movements, exploiting narrow waters and tidal changes of Chungcheong South Province Yellow Sea coast, at Cherry Island Battle (July 1592) sank 48 Japanese vessels with only 12 ships

Step 3 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Three crucial sea battles' consecutive victories — Cherry Island Battle (July 1592, sank 48 ships), Sacheon Battle (October 1592, burned over 300 Japanese vessels), Noryang Battle (December 1598,协同明軍 annihilating main Japanese force), achieving consecutive strategic victories with virtually no logistical support

Step 4 (Mode 15 Framing Effect): 'Not an inch to retreat' loyalty framework — redefining loyalty meaning through oath 'My death time has come, yet how could I avoid the enemy with death', framing 'no retreat' as national survival cultural symbol ('not an inch to retreat' became Korean national spirit emblem)

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Civil official's military system — condensing 'naval reform → intelligence network → terrain exploitation → loyalty framework' into an operable asymmetric defense template, proving strategic victories possible through systematic thinking and innovative tactics in absolute disadvantage
expected_zh: 掌握李舜臣從海軍改革到三次關鍵海戰的戰略路徑及其非對稱防禦體系的運作機制
理解龜船設計和鶴翼陣的系統性創新及其對現代海軍戰略的啟發
評估其非對稱戰爭理論（情報+地形+創新戰術）和忠誠精神對現代防禦戰略的持續啟發價值
expected_en: Master Yi Sun-sin's strategic path from naval reform to three crucial sea battles and operational mechanism of his asymmetric defense system
Understand Geobukseon design and Crane Wing Formation's systematic innovation and heuristic value for modern naval strategy
Evaluate the continuing heuristic value of his asymmetric warfare theory (intelligence + terrain + innovative tactics) and loyalty spirit for modern defense strategy
case_zh: 1545年出生於漢陽（今首爾）兩班家庭，父親李英蘭是地方官員。1576年通過武科考試進入軍旅生涯。1583年以別監身份平定全羅道海盜，初次展現軍事才能。1587年任命為全羅道左水使（該地區海軍司令），開始系統性改革朝鮮海軍。1592年4月日本文祿之役爆發，朝鮮水軍在漆川大海戰中幾乎被全滅。李舜臣臨危受命，僅率12艘龜船和5000名士兵應對日本300餘艘戰艦。7月閑居島之戰：利用狹窄水道限制日軍機動，以龜船裝甲抵禦火砲攻擊，擊沉48艘日軍艦艇。10月泗川海戰：利用夜間突襲焚毀日軍戰艦300餘艘。1597年丁酉再亂中，雖被削職（豐臣秀吉的第二次侵朝），但在鳴梁海戰中以12艘戰船擊毀日軍130餘艘。1598年露梁海戰中，與明朝水師協同殲滅日軍主力，但在戰鬥結束前被倭軍子彈擊中陣亡。他的《亂中日錄》（戰時日記）成為韓國最重要的歷史文獻之一，記錄了海軍戰略的詳細思考。《龜船》和「一寸也不能退」的精神成為韓國民族精神的象徵，被寫入教科書並紀念於多個歷史遺址。
case_en: Born 1545 in Han-yang (now Seoul) to yangban family; father Yi Yeong-nam was regional official. Entered military career through Military Examination in 1576. In 1583 served as Byeolgam suppressing Jeolla Province pirates, first demonstrating military talent. Appointed Jeolla Province Left Naval Commander in 1587, began systematic Korean navy reform. April 1592 Bunroku Campaign erupted; Korean navy nearly destroyed in Chokjin Sea Battle. Yi Sun-sin took command with only 12 Geobukseon (turtle ships) and 5000 soldiers facing over 300 Japanese vessels. July Cherry Island Battle: exploited narrow waters limiting Japanese maneuverability, used armored turtle ships to withstand cannon fire, sank 48 Japanese vessels. October Sacheon Battle: night raid burning over 300 Japanese ships. 1597 Dingyou Re-invasion, despite being demoted (Hideyoshi's second invasion), in Myeongnyang Battle sank over 130 Japanese vessels with 12 ships. December 1598 Noryang Battle,协同明軍 annihilating main Japanese force; shot by enemy bullet during final battle. His 'Nanjung Ilgi' (wartime diary) became one of Korea's most important historical documents, recording detailed naval strategic thinking. 'Geobukseon' and 'not an inch to retreat' spirit became Korean national spirit emblem, written in textbooks and commemorated at multiple historical sites.
cross_cultural_impact: Yi Sun-sin recognized as one of world's greatest naval commanders; 'not an inch to retreat' spirit studied in military academies worldwide
legal_system: 大韓律令體系下的武官（但非主要立法者）
education_tradition: 武科考試（系統性軍事教育，通過實踐不斷精進海軍戰略）
scientific_contribution: 否（但龜船設計涉及早期船舶工程技術的創新）
artistic_legacy: 是（其《亂中日錄》被視為韓國文學經典，多次改編為影視作品）
environmental_stewardship: 否（前現代社會，但海戰涉及沿海生態環境的間接影響）
gender_role_innovation: 否（但《亂中日錄》對後世女性海軍研究的啟發）
diaspora_network_type: 軍事（韓國海軍戰略思想在全球的傳播與研究）
digital_adaptation: 無（前數字時代，但其戰略思想被現代軍事學院廣泛研究）
regional_integration: 有（朝鮮與明朝聯合作戰的國際協調者）
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 非對稱海戰（通過情報+地形+創新戰術在絕對劣勢下取得戰略勝利）
